title: Agent work census: what stopping the person's daemon would cut
description: The daemon's own children that hold work: conversations whose handle holds a turn, a question, a person's command or Habitat's own work, a start under way, Pi background processes still running, or a Pi process bridge that does not answer clearly; and work without a handle. Native SSH, tmux and Taskfleet Pi are not the daemon's children and are not listed. Reading starts no Pi.

workspace_id.description: Absent when the handle names no workspace the daemon can identify; the conversation is listed all the same.

activities.description: turn: the person's turn, a start, or messages held or queued for it; question: Pi waits for the person's answer; command: a command the person ran through the conversation; habitat: Habitat's own use of the child (title, recap, its own wake, publishing the finished turn); processes: background processes Pi started still run; unknown: the child's state or its process bridge cannot be read with certainty.

name.description: Pi's label for the process, never its command line.

kind.description: history_title: a history being named without a handle (a title-model call and a temporary Pi); clone: a repository clone under way; workspace_operation: an operation holds the workspace writer (a publish's push, a deletion, an archive).
